items.title: How Kaynes Semicon Packages Chips Inside Its New Sanand Facility
items.summary: Step inside Kaynes Semicon's new semiconductor plant in Sanand, Gujarat, one of India's approved OSAT facilities under the India Semiconductor Mission. See how chips are packaged and tested, from wafer saw to final testing. In this exclusive Tech Talks interview, Sanjana Gupta, Tech Journalist, tours the plant with Raghu Panicker, CEO of Kaynes SemiCon, covering how the facility went from barren land to a working unit and what happens inside the clean room. Watch to understand how the special economic zone speeds up customs clearance, how the plant cleared around 35 licenses in eight months, how wafer mount, die attach, wire bonding, moulding, and testing work, and how reliability and failure analysis keep chip quality near 100%. items.title: The 45,000 GPU Myth: Are Indian AI Startups Stuck in a Subsidy Trap?
items.summary: Whenever we talk about India lagging behind in the global AI race, the default excuse is hardware. We point to the GPU shortage. But with the government stepping in and scaling the IndiaAI Mission to over 45,000 GPUs while subsidising compute for startups, the hardware excuse is running out of time. Are we blaming a lack of servers for deeper, systemic problems in our fundamental research, funding, and talent pipelines? items.title: The AI That Runs Without Internet: Inside India's Offline 'Dhīr' Model
items.summary: Switch your phone to aeroplane mode. Now ask it a question in Odia. Most of the AI you have heard about will wait politely for a signal that is never coming. Enter Dhīr: a small, open-source language model from ZenteiQ that runs entirely offline. Built to support English and ten Indian languages, it aims to put sovereign AI directly onto local servers and mobile devices. But India has announced "sovereign AI" before, and many of those announcements are still waiting for their first actual customer. Is Dhīr the real deal, or just another theoretical launch in the ₹10,371 crore IndiaAI Mission? In this episode of Front Page, we sit down with Professor Sashikumaar Ganesan of the Indian Institute of Science and founder of ZenteiQ, to test the claims behind India's newest AI model. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 📌 Note: The video thumbnail is for representational purposes and was created with the assistance of AI. 📩 For inquiries or questions, contact us at: info@aimmediahouse.com ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 📌 ABOUT FRONT PAGE Front Page is a daily live news briefing covering AI, enterprise tech, semiconductors, and India’s role in the global technology economy.
